name: Where people work
blurb: The surfaces leaders and analysts actually touch. Clear, focused, built around finance work — not chat for chat's sake.

nodes.name: CFO Cockpit
nodes.note: KPIs, close status, and variance alerts, at a glance.

nodes.name: Analyst Workspace
nodes.note: A workbench for adjustments, allocations, and drill-down.

nodes.name: Executive Dashboard
nodes.note: Board-ready narratives and trended packs.

nodes.name: Operations Console
nodes.note: For leaders watching jobs, exceptions, and SLAs.

nodes.name: Conversational Copilot
nodes.note: Plain-language questions, answered with citations.

nodes.name: Workflow Inbox
nodes.note: A single queue for approvals that need a human.

nodes.name: Mobile & Web
nodes.note: Push approvals and glance cards on any device.

name: Agents that do the work
blurb: Specialist agents that plan, delegate, and escalate. Each has a narrow job, a clear hand-off, and a supervisor above it.

nodes.name: Planner
nodes.note: Breaks goals into steps and routes work to specialists.

nodes.name: Finance Analyst
nodes.note: Runs variance, ratio, and driver analysis across ledgers.

nodes.name: Close & Consolidation
nodes.note: Handles reconciliations, intercompany, and FX.

nodes.name: Planning & Forecast
nodes.note: Builds driver-based models and scenarios.

nodes.name: Anomaly Detection
nodes.note: Flags outliers against trailing-period baselines.

nodes.name: Narrative Reporting
nodes.note: Drafts commentary, memos, and board packs.

nodes.name: Integration
nodes.note: Translates between systems. Never improvises.

nodes.name: Policy Guardrail
nodes.note: Pre- and post-flight checks. Blocks unsafe calls.

nodes.name: Human Approvals
nodes.note: Routes sensitive work to named approvers.

name: The runtime behind the agents
blurb: The scaffolding that runs agents, routes models, and remembers context across long-running work.

nodes.name: Orchestration Engine
nodes.note: Planner–critic loops, retries, fan-out / fan-in.

nodes.name: Prompt & Policy Engine
nodes.note: Templates, filters, and versioned policy packs.

nodes.name: Memory & Context
nodes.note: Short-term scratch and long-term episodic memory.

nodes.name: Retrieval & Vectors
nodes.note: Hybrid keyword + embedding search over corpora.

nodes.name: Model Router
nodes.note: Routes by task, latency, cost, residency, and risk.

nodes.name: Tool Registry
nodes.note: Typed tool manifests with scopes and descriptions.

nodes.name: Workflow Engine
nodes.note: Durable task graphs that survive restarts.

nodes.name: Event Bus
nodes.note: Pub / sub fabric for agent events and results.

nodes.name: Observability
nodes.note: Traces, evals, token spend, quality metrics.

name: MCP — governed tool access
blurb: One control plane for every tool. Every call is typed, scoped, and logged. Agents never touch systems directly.

nodes.name: MCP Server / Gateway
nodes.note: Exposes enterprise tools as typed capabilities.

nodes.name: Tool Catalog
nodes.note: Searchable registry of contracts, owners, and SLAs.

nodes.name: Secure Invocation
nodes.note: mTLS, signed requests, short-lived tokens.

nodes.name: API Mediation
nodes.note: Schema translation and graceful deprecation.

nodes.name: Context Injection
nodes.note: Binds tenant, entity, period, and user to each call.

nodes.name: Policy Enforcement
nodes.note: Checks who, what, when, and how much — every call.

nodes.name: Rate & Quota
nodes.note: Per-agent throttles and circuit breakers.

nodes.name: Tamper-Evident Audit
nodes.note: Append-only log with payload hashes.

name: Enterprise integration
blurb: The plumbing that bridges SaaS, on-prem, and event streams. Not glamorous. Load-bearing.

nodes.name: Integration Cloud / ESB
nodes.note: Adapters, process orchestration, file and API flows.

nodes.name: API Gateway
nodes.note: North-south traffic, quotas, schema validation.

nodes.name: Event Streaming
nodes.note: A durable log for financial events and CDC.

nodes.name: REST & SOAP
nodes.note: Domain services fronting systems of record.

nodes.name: File Integration
nodes.note: Secure drop-zones, SFTP, batch feeds with reconciliation.

nodes.name: Process Orchestration
nodes.note: Long-running, human-in-loop business processes.

nodes.name: Adapters
nodes.note: Typed connectors with retry, dead-letter, and replay.

nodes.name: Master & Metadata
nodes.note: Chart-of-accounts, entities, hierarchies, mappings.
